interpretation: On this controller and cable, failure depended on how early the first enumeration starts. When the host sends its first request roughly 0.6 s after FNK0099 starts, it often fails (cold) or always fails (EN reset with the SFC powered), and after one failure the SFC no longer answers on later bus resets. Starting the first enumeration about 1.5 s after boot enumerated every time in both conditions (10/10). The roughly 10 ms later start of rcv1-pp was enough for cold power-on (8/8) but not for the EN-reset case (0/5). Why the SFC is not ready around 0.6 s (for example the USB-Serial-JTAG D+ pull-up during ESP32 reset, or the UIAPduino bootloader-to-application handover) is not established. Sample sizes are small, only the first controller and the C-to-C cable were used, and the minimum sufficient delay was not measured.
